'''Shroud SF-4''' was a member of the [[The Shroud's syndicate|intelligence network]] that served the independent operative known as [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. SF-4 was sent to [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] to observe [[Asset K-33|Imperial asset K-33]].

==Biography==
Shroud SF-4 was a member of the [[The Shroud's syndicate|intelligence network]] that served the independent operative known as [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Shroud SF-4 was stationed at [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] to observe Imperial Asset K-33, an Imperial agent undercover in the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. K-33 married into the [[House Kuat|Kuat family]], giving him more political power.<ref name="Web" />

K-33 took up residence in the [[Kuat Drive Yards Governor Quarters]]. K-33 took control of the Kuat Drive Yards security oversight. SF-4 took the guise of a shipyard administrator concerned with lax security so that he can learn about the security of the Drive Yards. K-33 promised to take SF-4 through the security measures as an act of reassurance. SF-4 made an analysis that several newly made capital ships could be liberated for the network. SF-4 intercepted a transmission from K-33 to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Zasha Ranken|Ranken]], in which K-33 suggested a [[Kuat Defensive Station|single defensive station]] was key to subverting all Kuat Drive Yards security protocols.<ref name="Web" />

K-33 found SF-4 out, and stabbed SF-4 in the back with a [[Vibroknife/Legends|vibroknife]], although SF-4 managed to transmit the logs to the Shroud before he [[Death/Legends|died]]. The Shroud sold the information provided by SF-4 through numerous intermediaries for the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] to obtain, prompting the Republic to start mounting a force to counter the Sith Empire's invasion. The Shroud sent [[Asset SF-5]] to dispose of SF-4's body and belongings, and to observe the outcome of the [[Battle of Kuat (Galactic War)|Battle for Kuat]].<ref name="Web" />
